findings.rule: References should be numbered sequentially as they appear in the text, tables and figure legends. Only references actually cited in the manuscript should appear in the list.
findings.problem: Only references [1], [2], [4], and [8] are cited in the body text. References [3] (Tama & Sanejouand), [5] (Nishimura & Morisawa), [6] (Togashi & Mikhailov), [7] (Ikeguchi et al.), [9] (Adachi et al.), [10] (Ichimura et al.), [11] (Itoh et al., in press), and [12] (Yasuda et al.) appear in the reference list but are never cited in the text, tables, or figure legends.
